verdict.rationale: Built-in panes and tabs are a fair question for a terminal emulator, so the axis applies. Alacritty's own README says "you won't find things like tabs or splits (which are best left to a window manager or terminal multiplexer)," and users report leaving over the lack of tabs. Its multi-window support is an adjacent feature, not panes or tabs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can split windows into panes and organize work across tabs without an external multiplexer
